name: Integrated Rendering Environment for Volume Clipping and Measurement
definition: A rendering framework that integrates 3D widgets and volume clipping with volume rendering to allow immersive exploration and quantitative measurement (area, distance, angle) of 3D medical images. It solves the problem that standard volume rendering algorithms (ray casting, splatting, shear warp) produce only a 2D projection image without intermediate depth information, making it difficult to correctly display clipping planes and widgets in 3D space alongside the volume.
summary: It integrates 3D widgets with volume clipping and rendering to enable immersive exploration and quantitative measurement of 3D medical images by reconstructing depth information from 2D projections for correct occlusion handling.
